content:
I need to answer a GAIA benchmark question about reality TV competition shows. 

Please fetch the Wikipedia page for Survivor (American TV series) at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Survivor_(American_TV_series) using any method available to you. I need to know:

1. All winners of Survivor US seasons 1 through 44
2. Which winners won multiple times (i.e., unique winners)

Also fetch the Wikipedia page for American Idol at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/American_Idol to get all winners.

Finally, compute: as of the end of the 44th season of Survivor US, how many more unique winners has Survivor had compared to American Idol?

Please use websearch and/or webfetch tools to research this information. Be thorough and verify your data.
I'll fetch both Wikipedia pages and research the winners. Let me start by getting the data from both pages.

import urllib.request

resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15)
html = resp.read().decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
print(len(html))
" 2>&1
